question: Who among the following was conferred with the Padma Shri Award, 2021, for populating folk dance in rural Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is Mathu B Manjamma Jogathi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On November 9, **President Ram Nath Kovind **presented the **Padma Shri Award** to transgender **folk dancer Manjamma Jogati at Rashtrapati Bhavan.**
 
• **Manjamma Jogathi** is the first transgender president of the **Karnataka Janapada Academy and a trans folk dancer of the Jogamma lineage.**
 
• She received her award while the audience applauded while wearing a purple Ilkal saree and blessing the **President** in the traditional manner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rama Swamy Annavarapu**

 
 
• **​Indian classical violinist Annavarapu Rama Swamy **was born in **Andhra Pradesh **on March 27, 1926.
 
• His contributions to the **world of Carnatic music** are well known. He is renowned for creating new **Ragas and Talas** including the** Vedadi Tala, Tinetradi Tala, and Sri Durga Raga.**
 
• He received the **Padma Shri,** the fourth-highest civilian honour in India, in the arts and literature category in 2021.
 
 
 
• **Pappammal**
 
 
• Tamil **Nadu-born Pappammal (or Papammal, born 1914) is an Indian organic farmer.**
 
• She is thought to be the oldest farmer who is still working in the field at the age of 105.
 
• She is associated with the teaching department of the** Tamil Nadu Agricultural University and is known as a pioneer in the agricultural industry.**​
